openingNote: Where adaptive governance has been studied, and how unevenly.
descentNote: Qatar holds no studies. The Gulf holds one.
nodesNote: Five work packages. Evidence this project is creating.

stillAlt.whole: The whole globe. Every country the corpus reaches is raised off the sphere and shaded by how many studies it holds, so the darkest and tallest are the most studied.
stillAlt.separated: The same globe with two translucent shells lifted clear of it, the global layer furthest out and the regional layer between it and the sphere the national and local layer stands for.
stillAlt.descended: The globe at the end of the sequence. The Gulf seen from above, most of the region unlit, Qatar outlined and empty, and five nodes around Doha marking the work packages.

panel.label: The corpus, by country
panel.indexDetail: Choose one to see its records beside the globe. The globe itself is the same choice, made on the map.
